programs.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programs.desc: Danica and her friends cause an accident.They enter into a pact of silence rather than face the consequences.A year later, the secret is revealed - someone knows what they did and wants revenge.

programs.title: Guy Ritchie's the Covenant
programs.desc: March 2018.There is a war in Afghanistan.Master Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and his unit are ambushed by the Taliban during a routine vehicle inspection.The American translator dies in it.He will be replaced by Ahmed Abdullah (Dar Salim).During a secret mission, Kinley learns that his new associate had previous ties to the Taliban.He escaped when the organization murdered his son.Over time, an alliance develops between him and the American soldier.Ahmed saves John, who after some time gains the opportunity to repay his debt.

actor: Master Sergeant John Kinley - Jake Gyllenhaal

programs.title: Peacemaker 2
programs.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programs.title: Half Man
programs.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programs.title: Insomnia
programs.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programs.title: The Idea of You
programs.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.
